title: Second Brain Project Overview
content: The project titled 'Second Brain' aims to save all information consumed. The system uses cloud technology, open-source learning management systems (OLAMA, Quen, Qwen, Whisper, Flow), and a free non-open-source tool (Gemini). The project is compiled in Python, but the user has not personally contributed any code. All developments are facilitated by the cloud and open-source resources.
